policy: Owner policy, 28 Nov 2026: only openly licensed models may ship. A model passes only if its weights licence allows commercial redistribution AND is not undermined by non-commercial, research-only or unverified training-data terms. GREEN = clean. AMBER = explicit open licence but training data or weights terms not fully confirmed (listed in docs/notices/THIRD-PARTY-MODELS.md for the owner). RED = cannot show it is clean; must not ship by default (shipDefault false, out of the installer, off by default). Not legal advice. Source: licence audit of 28 Nov 2026 (nothing downloaded, no licence accepted).
fields: id; name; ids (every id the code uses for it: catalogue, pack, slot, manifest); files (repo-relative paths, or bare file names, `*` allowed); feature; where (installer | download | tooling | data); shipDefault (true if a default installer or default-on feature carries it); codeLicence; weightsLicence; trainingData; verdict; reason; sources; reviewed (YYYY-MM-DD); notice (what must be shipped); noticeFile (optional, in docs/notices).

models.name: U2-Netp (subject mask)
models.feature: Subject mask for masks and crops
models.trainingData: DUTS (ImageNet-derived images; annotations 'all rights reserved by the original authors'; no commercial grant)
models.reason: Weights trained on DUTS, which carries no commercial grant; weights licence not stated.

models.name: BiRefNet_lite (fine subject edges)
models.trainingData: DIS5K (non-commercial research and education only; commercial use prohibited without author permission), plus DUTS, HRSOD and others unconfirmed
models.reason: Training set DIS5K terms (read first-hand) prohibit commercial use without permission; other sets unconfirmed.

models.name: EfficientSAM-Ti (tap to select)
models.trainingData: SA-1B (Meta: 'research purposes only'; licence text not readable) and ImageNet pretraining (from memory, not read)
models.reason: Cannot show neither SA-1B nor ImageNet pretraining permits commercial use; no weights licence.

models.name: NAFNet-SIDD-w32 (learned noise reduction)
models.trainingData: SIDD train; dataset authors state MIT, nothing on rights in the photographed scenes
models.reason: Dataset owners state MIT, but there is no weights licence and scene rights are unstated. Email Megvii and the SIDD authors to upgrade.
models.notice: MIT notice for NAFNet and for BasicSR (Apache-2.0) must ship

models.name: BioCLIP v1 (species, 8-bit image encoder)
models.trainingData: TreeOfLife-10M: iNat21 (non-commercial research and education only), BIOSCAN-1M (CC BY-NC-SA), EOL (CC0 to CC BY-NC-SA); initialised from OpenAI CLIP
models.reason: Training data includes non-commercial terms; no statement that weights may be used commercially.

models.name: BioCLIP 2 (species second opinion)
models.trainingData: TreeOfLife-200M (iNaturalist/GBIF, observation.org, EOL, BIOSCAN; licensing prose not readable) plus 26M LAION-2B replay samples
models.reason: Strict policy: cleanliness of the training sources cannot be shown.

models.name: Species vector files made with BioCLIP
models.trainingData: BioCLIP text embeddings of species names; the names themselves are CC BY 4.0 / CC0
models.reason: Inherits BioCLIP's verdict (embeddings are BioCLIP output). The name lists are clean.

models.name: CLIP ViT-B/32 (image + text encoders, category gate, text search)
models.feature: Category gate before species; Search by description
models.reason: MIT is explicit, but OpenAI's model card says any deployed use, commercial or not, is out of scope, and the data is undisclosed. Leaning RED; a policy call for the owner. Whether the three vectors.json files were built with CLIP text was not verified.

models.name: DINOv2 ViT-S/14 (burst grouping; RF-DETR backbone)
models.trainingData: LVD-142M: described only as curated images; terms not confirmed
models.reason: Explicit Apache grant; training-data terms unconfirmed. Low risk.

models.name: YOLOX-Tiny (subject detector)
models.trainingData: COCO (annotations CC BY 4.0 from memory; images mixed Flickr licences; terms page returned no text)
models.reason: Apache code, weights licence not stated, COCO terms not confirmed. Widely shipped commercially. Low risk.

models.name: RF-DETR Nano (second subject finder)
models.weightsLicence: Apache-2.0 for Nano only (larger sizes are PML, not ours)
models.trainingData: COCO; DINOv2 backbone inherits its caveats
models.reason: Apache confirmed for Nano; inherits DINOv2 and COCO caveats. Low risk.

models.name: SmolVLM2 256M / 500M (photo check, vision critic)
models.trainingData: Ten fine-tune sets, at least one academic-research-only (LLaVA-Video-178K, to verify); FineVideo and M4-Instruct carry caveats; six sets unchecked; SigLIP encoder on WebLI (terms not stated)
models.reason: Apache licence, but at least one stated training source is academic-only. Biggest open question of the AMBER set. Email HuggingFaceTB.

models.name: Florence-2-base (tooling only)
models.feature: Vision lab and model scripts only; not in the app
models.reason: Appears only in scripts/models/manifest.json and tools/vision-lab. Confirm before it ever ships.
models.notice: MIT text if it ever ships

models.name: PP-OCRv5 mobile detector + English recogniser
models.reason: Explicit Apache grant; training data undescribed. Low risk.
